laymanSummary: Semaglutide is the **GLP-1** peptide behind *Ozempic* and *Wegovy* — the compound that kicked off the modern weight-research wave. It copies a gut hormone the body releases after eating, so it ~curbs appetite~, ~slows stomach emptying~, and ~steadies blood sugar~. In large human trials people saw up to ~15% body-weight reduction~ over roughly 16 months. A built-in fatty-acid chain lets it last about a week per dose, so it's studied as a *once-weekly* peptide.
name: Semaglutide — 5mg
shortDescription: Research-grade GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
Research-grade Semaglutide peptide supplied as a lyophilized powder in a single 5mg vial. Intended strictly for laboratory and in-vitro research applications. Each lot is tested for purity by HPLC and ships sealed with a certificate of analysis on request.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: GLP-1 receptor agonist with high affinity for GLP-1R. Mediates glucose-dependent insulin secretion, suppresses glucagon, and delays gastric emptying. C18 fatty acid chain with albumin linker extends plasma half-life to approximately 7 days, enabling once-weekly dosing in research models.
receptorActivity: Primary: GLP-1R (high affinity, Ki ~0.5 nM). No meaningful activity at GIP-R, GCGR, or other incretin receptors at physiological concentrations.
pathwaySummary: GLP-1R → cAMP/PKA/CREB cascade → glucose-dependent potentiation of pancreatic β-cell insulin exocytosis. Hypothalamic arcuate nucleus satiety circuit activation via vagal afferents and central GLP-1R expression.

knownStudies.title: Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity (STEP 1)
notes: n=1,961 adults, 68-week trial
14.9% mean body weight reduction vs 2.4% placebo
50.5% of participants lost ≥15% body weight at max dose

26% reduction in composite MACE endpoint vs placebo
Non-fatal stroke RRR: 39%

20% reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events
First trial to show CV benefit in non-diabetic obesity population

knownStudies.title: GLP-1 receptor agonism attenuates neuroinflammation and amyloid pathology in Alzheimer mouse models
notes: Reduced Aβ plaque burden and microglial activation
Mechanism: suppression of NF-κB-mediated inflammatory signaling

laymanSummary: Tirzepatide is the **dual GIP + GLP-1** peptide behind *Mounjaro* and *Zepbound*. By switching on **two gut-hormone receptors at once**, it ~suppresses appetite~ and ~improves how the body handles sugar and fat~ more powerfully than GLP-1 alone. In head-to-head human trials it reached up to ~22% body-weight reduction~ — beating *semaglutide*. Like the rest of its class, it's a *once-weekly* compound.
name: Tirzepatide — 10mg
shortDescription: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. Lyophilized, 10mg vial.
longDescription:
Tirzepatide supplied as a lyophilized powder in a single 10mg vial. Intended strictly for laboratory and in-vitro research applications. Each lot is tested for purity by HPLC and ships sealed with a certificate of analysis on request.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist with near-equipotent activity at both receptor subtypes. GIP component enhances incretin amplification and adipocyte lipid metabolism; GLP-1 component mediates gastric emptying inhibition and central satiety signaling. Synergistic metabolic regulation exceeds either mono-agonist in research models.
receptorActivity: GIP-R (EC50 ~0.04 nM) and GLP-1R (EC50 ~0.13 nM). Dual coagonism without significant glucagon receptor activity. GIP component acts as full agonist at GIP-R; GLP-1 component retains full GLP-1R agonism.
pathwaySummary: GIP-R → cAMP/PKA axis in pancreatic β-cells and adipocytes, PI3K/Akt in fat tissue. GLP-1R → cAMP/EPAC/PKA, hypothalamic satiety (arcuate nucleus), gastric motility suppression via vagal pathways.

knownStudies.title: Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide Once Weekly in Type 2 Diabetes (SURPASS-2)
notes: n=1,879 participants, 40-week trial
All tirzepatide doses statistically superior to semaglutide 1mg for HbA1c
Up to 2.4% HbA1c reduction at 15mg dose

knownStudies.title: Tirzepatide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Obesity (SURMOUNT-1)
notes: n=2,539 adults, 72-week trial
22.5% mean body weight reduction at 15mg vs 2.4% placebo
63.3% of participants achieved ≥20% body weight loss at 15mg

knownStudies.title: Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonism activates brown adipose tissue thermogenesis via UCP-1
notes: Tirzepatide-analog showed 2.3× greater UCP-1 upregulation vs GLP-1 mono
Mechanism: GIP component directly activates brown adipocyte GIP-R

name: Retatrutide — 5mg
shortDescription: Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
Retatrutide supplied as a lyophilized powder in a single 5mg vial. Intended strictly for laboratory and in-vitro research applications. Each lot is tested for purity by HPLC and ships sealed with a certificate of analysis on request.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
laymanSummary: Retatrutide is the newest and most powerful peptide in the **GLP-1 weight-research** family. In *human clinical trials*, participants lost up to ~24% of their body weight~ over roughly 11 months — the largest reduction reported for any compound in this class so far. It works by switching on **three receptors at once** — GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon — which together ~curb appetite~, ~steady blood sugar~, and ~raise how many calories the body burns~. In plain terms, it is a step beyond *semaglutide* (Ozempic) and *tirzepatide* (Mounjaro).
mechanismSummary: Triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist. The glucagon component drives hepatic glucose output reduction and direct energy expenditure increase via brown adipose tissue thermogenesis, amplifying the metabolic efficacy of the dual GIP/GLP-1 axis. Highest efficacy metabolic profile in the incretin class.
receptorActivity: GIP-R (EC50 ~0.04 nM), GLP-1R (EC50 ~0.02 nM), GCGR (EC50 ~1.1 nM). Balanced triple activation. Glucagon receptor activity is titrated below the hyperglycemia threshold while driving energy expenditure.
pathwaySummary: Incretin axis (GIP + GLP-1): insulin secretion amplification, satiety signaling. Glucagon axis (GCGR): hepatic glycogenolysis suppression, direct thermogenic effect via UCP-1 upregulation in brown adipose tissue.
fdaStatus: Investigational — Phase 3 program ongoing; not FDA approved

Appetite suppression and reduced caloric intake observed

notes: ~17% body weight reduction in diet-induced obese mice
Increased energy expenditure and improved glucose tolerance
Balanced triple-receptor agonism characterized in vitro

notes: −8.96% mean body weight and −1.42% HbA1c at 12 mg, 12 weeks
Dose-dependent glucose lowering
Acceptable safety and tolerability profile

laymanSummary: Ipamorelin is a **growth-hormone-releasing** peptide that nudges the pituitary to put out its own *natural GH pulse*. What makes it a research favorite is its **clean selectivity** — it ~raises growth hormone~ without the cortisol, prolactin, or hunger spikes that older peptides like GHRP-6 cause. It's short-acting, so it mimics the body's own rhythmic GH bursts rather than flooding the system.
name: Ipamorelin — 5mg
shortDescription: Selective GHS-R1a agonist. No cortisol or prolactin elevation. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
Ipamorelin is a selective pentapeptide growth hormone secretagogue receptor agonist (GHS-R1a). It stimulates pulsatile GH release from anterior pituitary somatotrophs with a high selectivity profile that avoids concurrent elevation of cortisol, prolactin, or ACTH. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 5mg sealed vial. Each lot is tested for purity by HPLC and ships with a certificate of analysis.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: Selective GHS-R1a agonist that stimulates pulsatile GH release from anterior pituitary somatotrophs. High receptor selectivity distinguishes it from first-generation GHRPs — no concurrent elevation of cortisol, prolactin, or ACTH at research-relevant concentrations. EC50 ~1.3 nM at GHS-R1a.
receptorActivity: Selective GHS-R1a (growth hormone secretagogue receptor 1a). No binding at GH-receptor, IGF-1R, or pituitary receptors outside the GHS-R subfamily. No binding at cortisol, prolactin, or ACTH pathways at therapeutic concentrations.
pathwaySummary: GHS-R1a → Gq-coupled → IP3/DAG/PKC cascade → somatotroph intracellular Ca2+ release → GH secretory granule exocytosis. Independent of the GHRH axis; acts via a distinct intracellular signaling cascade that permits additive GH secretion when combined with GHRH analogues.

knownStudies.title: Ipamorelin — characterization of a novel selective growth hormone secretagogue
notes: Full GHS-R1a agonist profile characterized
No ACTH, cortisol, or prolactin elevation at GH-stimulating doses
Distinct selectivity vs GHRP-2 and GHRP-6 analogs

knownStudies.title: Safety and tolerability of ipamorelin in healthy adult volunteers — PK/PD study
notes: Confirmed dose-dependent GH secretion in humans
No HPA axis activation confirmed at all doses tested
Favorable safety profile with no dose-limiting toxicity

knownStudies.title: Ipamorelin accelerates postoperative upper gastrointestinal transit in dogs
knownStudies.source: Journal of Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics
notes: GHS-R1a agonism normalized GI motility following surgery
Potential application in postoperative ileus research models

laymanSummary: CJC-1295 with **DAC** is a long-acting **GHRH** analogue — it tells the pituitary to release growth hormone, and a clever albumin-binding tag keeps it working for *6–8 days* per dose. It ~raises baseline GH and IGF-1~ steadily rather than in spikes, and in research it's often paired with a GHRP like ipamorelin so the two *amplify each other*.
name: CJC-1295 DAC — 2mg
shortDescription: GHRH analogue with Drug Affinity Complex albumin-binding technology. Lyophilized, 2mg vial.
longDescription:
CJC-1295 with Drug Affinity Complex (DAC) is a synthetic GHRH analogue with a maleimido-propionic acid group that forms a covalent bond with albumin cysteine-34 in vivo, extending half-life to 6–8 days. Used in GH axis research models where sustained GHRH-axis stimulation is required. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 2mg sealed vial with certificate of analysis.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: GHRH analogue with Drug Affinity Complex (DAC) albumin-binding technology. The maleimido-propionic acid group forms a covalent bond with albumin cysteine-34, extending half-life to 6–8 days. Maintains the sustained GH and IGF-1 axis stimulation profile of native GHRH without frequent dosing.
receptorActivity: GHRH receptor (GHRHR) agonist. DAC modification enables albumin binding (Kd ~2 μM for HSA Cys-34) without disrupting peptide–receptor interactions. Full agonism at GHRHR is maintained post-DAC conjugation.
pathwaySummary: GHRHR → Gs-coupled → adenylyl cyclase → cAMP → PKA → GH gene transcription and somatotroph Ca2+ sensitization. Sustained plasma levels from albumin binding extend the GHRH pulse without altering downstream GH/IGF-1 pathway mechanics.

laymanSummary: BPC-157 is a **body-protection peptide** first found in stomach fluid, and it's the headliner of *tissue-repair research*. It promotes **new blood-vessel growth** and ~speeds healing of tendon, muscle, and gut tissue~ in animal models. Unusually for a peptide it stays *stable in stomach acid*, which is why it's so widely studied for gut and injury-recovery applications.
name: BPC-157 — 5mg
shortDescription: Pentadecapeptide fragment of body protection compound. Angiogenic and regenerative research model. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
BPC-157 is a 15-amino-acid peptide fragment derived from a protein found in human gastric juice. Research applications span tissue healing models, angiogenesis assays, and growth factor receptor upregulation studies. Stable in aqueous solution across a wide pH range. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 5mg sealed vial with certificate of analysis.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: Pentadecapeptide fragment of body protection compound derived from human gastric juice. Promotes angiogenesis via VEGF receptor-2 upregulation, enhances growth factor receptor expression, and activates the FAK-paxillin pathway. Stable in aqueous solution under acidic and neutral pH — notable in vitro stability profile.
receptorActivity: Activates VEGF receptor-2 (VEGFR-2/KDR) and epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR). Upregulates FAK-paxillin pathway and NO synthase signaling. No direct receptor binding identified for the intact pentadecapeptide; activity is primarily via growth factor receptor sensitization and downstream kinase cascades.
pathwaySummary: VEGFR-2 → PI3K/Akt/eNOS → NO production → endothelial cell proliferation and migration. FAK-paxillin → cytoskeletal reorganization for fibroblast and myoblast migration. Upregulates EGF and FGF receptor expression in target tissue.
fdaStatus: Not approved — preclinical / research use only

knownStudies.title: Stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157: novel therapy of the gastrointestinal tract
notes: Comprehensive review of 25+ years of BPC-157 preclinical research
Gastric ulcer healing, IBD models, gut-brain axis modulation documented
Stable in gastric acid — unique among peptide therapeutics

knownStudies.title: BPC-157 counteracts tendon-to-bone healing deficits — mechanical and histological analysis
notes: Superior tendon insertion strength vs control at 4 and 8 weeks post-surgery
Enhanced collagen fiber alignment and reduced scar tissue at repair site

knownStudies.title: BPC-157 promotes angiogenesis via VEGFR-2/FAK/paxillin in endothelial cultures
notes: VEGFR-2 phosphorylation confirmed at sub-micromolar concentrations
FAK-paxillin pathway activation drives endothelial cell migration and tube formation

knownStudies.title: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 and muscle injury: acceleration of recovery and NO pathway
notes: Accelerated recovery of muscle force production following crush injury
Upregulation of eNOS and nNOS in recovering myofibers

laymanSummary: TB-500 is a synthetic version of **thymosin β4**, a healing protein found throughout the body. It works on the cell's internal scaffolding (**actin**) to help cells ~migrate to injury sites~, ~build new blood vessels~, and ~reduce scar tissue~. It's a staple of *regeneration and recovery research*, often studied alongside BPC-157 for combined tissue repair.
name: TB-500 — 5mg
shortDescription: Synthetic thymosin β4 analogue. Actin polymerization, tissue repair research. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
TB-500 is a synthetic analogue of the naturally occurring peptide thymosin β4. Research applications span musculoskeletal repair models, cardiac tissue studies, and directed cell migration assays. Acts via G-actin sequestration and activation of PI3K/Akt survival pathways. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 5mg sealed vial with certificate of analysis.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: Synthetic peptide analogue of thymosin β4. Upregulates the actin-sequestering G-actin pool, promotes endothelial and smooth muscle cell migration, and activates PI3K/Akt survival pathways. Investigated in cardiac and musculoskeletal repair models. Acts primarily via cytoskeletal reorganization rather than classical receptor-ligand binding.
receptorActivity: Acts via G-actin sequestration (Kd ~0.8 nM for G-actin). Activates Akt/protein kinase B and ILK (integrin-linked kinase). Upregulates matrix metalloproteinase-2 for extracellular matrix remodeling. Primary effect is cytoskeletal rather than classical receptor-ligand.
pathwaySummary: PI3K/Akt/ILK → inhibition of apoptosis, activation of cell survival. G-actin sequestration promotes lamellipodia formation and directed cell migration. MMP-2 upregulation for basement membrane remodeling in tissue repair contexts.

laymanSummary: Semax is a Russian-developed **nootropic** peptide built from a fragment of ACTH. It ~boosts BDNF and NGF~ — the brain's own growth factors — which is why it's studied for *focus, memory, and neuroprotection*. It's also protective in stroke models and is taken intranasally so it reaches the brain quickly.
name: Semax — 30mg
shortDescription: ACTH(4-7) Pro-Gly-Pro analogue. BDNF/NGF upregulation, cognitive research model. Lyophilized, 30mg vial.
longDescription:
Semax is a synthetic analogue of the ACTH(4-7) peptide fragment with a Pro-Gly-Pro C-terminal extension that confers resistance to enzymatic degradation. Research applications include neurotrophic factor regulation models, cognitive function studies, and neuroprotective assays. Upregulates BDNF, NGF, and VEGF expression in cortical and hippocampal tissue preparations. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 30mg sealed vial.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: ACTH(4-7) Pro-Gly-Pro analogue with enhanced enzymatic stability. Upregulates BDNF, NGF, and VEGF expression in cortical and hippocampal tissue. Inhibits prolyl oligopeptidase (PO), the primary enkephalin degradation enzyme, extending neuropeptide half-life at cortical synapses. Penetrates the blood-brain barrier via intranasal and parenteral routes.
receptorActivity: Binds BDNF/TrkB signaling complex and stimulates endogenous BDNF upregulation. Inhibits prolyl oligopeptidase (EC 3.4.21.26) — the primary enkephalin/MIF-1 degradation enzyme — extending neuropeptide half-life at cortical synapses. No direct binding at classical neuroreceptor subtypes.
pathwaySummary: TrkB (BDNF receptor) → Ras/MAPK/ERK → CREB → pro-survival gene transcription. PO inhibition → elevated enkephalin and MIF-1 concentrations at cortical synapses → modulation of dopaminergic and serotonergic tone.

laymanSummary: Epitalon is a four-amino-acid **pineal peptide** at the center of *longevity research*. In studies it ~activates telomerase~ — the enzyme that maintains the protective caps on our DNA — and ~helps restore natural melatonin rhythms~. Because of this it's explored as an **anti-aging and circadian** bioregulator.
name: Epitalon — 10mg
shortDescription: Tetrapeptide pineal peptide extract analogue. Telomerase activation, longevity research model. Lyophilized, 10mg vial.
longDescription:
Epitalon (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) is a synthetic tetrapeptide derived from the bovine pineal peptide preparation Epithalamin. Research applications include telomerase regulation studies, circadian biology models, and aging biology research. Reported to activate telomerase in somatic cells and upregulate pineal melatonin synthesis. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 10mg sealed vial.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: Tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) derived from the bovine pineal peptide preparation Epithalamin. Activates telomerase (hTERT) in aging somatic cells and upregulates pineal melatonin synthesis via N-acetyltransferase. Primary research applications in longevity biology, circadian regulation, and neuroendocrine aging models.
receptorActivity: Activates telomerase (hTERT) in aging somatic cells. Upregulates melatonin synthesis via pinealocyte N-acetyltransferase. No direct receptor identification for the intact tetrapeptide; activity mediated through intranuclear chromatin-modifying mechanisms.
pathwaySummary: hTERT (telomerase reverse transcriptase) activation → telomere elongation in somatic cells. Pineal N-acetyltransferase upregulation → melatonin synthesis restoration. Chromatin decondensation in aging cells → re-expression of silenced gene clusters.

laymanSummary: AOD-9604 is a small **fat-loss fragment** of growth hormone. It ~triggers fat breakdown and burning~ through the β-3 receptor *without* touching blood sugar or the IGF-1 growth pathway — so it targets **fat metabolism specifically**, without the broader effects of full growth hormone.
name: AOD-9604 — 5mg
shortDescription: hGH C-terminal fragment. Selective β-3 adrenergic lipolysis without IGF-1 axis involvement. Lyophilized, 5mg vial.
longDescription:
AOD-9604 is the C-terminal fragment of human growth hormone (hGH176-191) modified with a tyrosine residue at position 176. Research applications center on selective lipolysis models where GH receptor activation and IGF-1 axis involvement must be excluded as variables. Activates β-3 adrenergic receptors in adipocytes without binding the GH receptor. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 5mg sealed vial.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: C-terminal fragment of human growth hormone (hGH176-191) modified with a tyrosine at position 176. Activates β-3 adrenergic receptors to stimulate lipolysis in adipocytes without binding the GH receptor or affecting IGF-1 levels. Selective lipolytic profile without growth-promoting or diabetogenic effects.
receptorActivity: Selective β-3 adrenergic receptor (ADRB3) agonist in adipocytes. Does not bind GH receptor (GHR) or IGF-1R. No demonstrable interaction with insulin receptor or insulin-like growth factor pathway components.
pathwaySummary: ADRB3 → Gs → cAMP → PKA → hormone-sensitive lipase (HSL) phosphorylation → triglyceride hydrolysis in white adipocytes. Simultaneously activates UCP-1 in brown adipose tissue (BAT) for thermogenesis. Bypasses the growth hormone receptor — no IGF-1 axis involvement.

laymanSummary: KPV is a tiny three-amino-acid tail of the **α-MSH** hormone with an outsized **anti-inflammatory** punch. It ~calms overactive immune signaling~ (NF-κB and STAT3) and is studied in *gut inflammation, IBD, and wound-healing* models — delivering melanocortin's calming effects without affecting skin pigment.
name: KPV — 10mg
shortDescription: α-MSH C-terminal tripeptide. MC1R/MC3R agonist, NF-κB suppression. Lyophilized, 10mg vial.
longDescription:
KPV is the C-terminal tripeptide (Lys-Pro-Val) of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH). Research applications include inflammatory bowel disease models, wound healing assays, and systemic inflammatory response studies. Acts as an MC1R and MC3R melanocortin receptor agonist to suppress NF-κB and STAT3 signaling. Supplied as a lyophilized powder in a 10mg sealed vial.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.
mechanismSummary: C-terminal tripeptide of α-MSH (Lys-Pro-Val). Agonist at MC1R and MC3R melanocortin receptors. Suppresses NF-κB and STAT3 inflammatory signaling pathways and inhibits neutrophil recruitment. Research applications in colitis, wound healing, and systemic inflammatory models.
receptorActivity: Agonist at MC1R (melanocortin 1 receptor, Ki ~50 nM) and MC3R (Ki ~200 nM). Antagonizes NF-κB nuclear translocation. Inhibits STAT3 phosphorylation (Tyr705) and downstream cytokine expression. No significant activity at MC2R (ACTH receptor) or MC5R.
pathwaySummary: MC1R/MC3R → cAMP → inhibition of NF-κB (IKKβ phosphorylation suppression) → reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine transcription. Blocks STAT3 (Tyr705) phosphorylation → reduced IL-6 and IL-17 signaling. Inhibits neutrophil and macrophage recruitment at inflammatory foci.

name: Bacteriostatic Water — 30 mL
shortDescription: 0.9% benzyl alcohol in sterile water. 30mL multi-dose vial.
longDescription:
Sterile bacteriostatic water suitable for laboratory reconstitution of lyophilized peptides and other research compounds. Preserved with 0.9% benzyl alcohol for multi-dose use. Supplied in a 30mL sealed glass vial with rubber septum.

Not for human use. For research purposes only.

name: Research Syringes — 1mL, Box of 100
